Estimates

Source: R/ScMaSigProClass.R
Estimates-class.Rd

The models that sc.t.fit() selected.

Value

An object of class Estimates: the selected model of each gene, which sc.t.fit() stores in the Estimate slot of a ScMaSigPro object. showSol() and the other result readers return its matrices.

Details

validObject() checks that t_score_matrix has the shape and rows of coefficient_matrix, that path_coefficient_matrix has its rows, and that every row of significance_matrix is a row of coefficient_matrix.

Slots

significance_matrix

For each gene with a significant selected model, its p-value and R-squared and the p-value of each term (showSol()).

coefficient_matrix

The coefficients (showCoeff()).

path_coefficient_matrix

The coefficients of the polynomial of each path (showGroupCoeff()).

t_score_matrix

The t statistics (showTS()).

path

The path of the intercept and of each term.

influential

The genes with influential observations (showInflu()).

See also

Other classes: MatrixDesign, ParameterConfig, ScMaSigPro, Significant, VariableProfiles, updateObject,ScMaSigPro-method
